title: Simulate > Propulsion simulation
captureState: Seeded fixture; Simulate > Propulsion simulation; Visual flow tier; study 'Study 01' (sims/<id>.rw.toml kind = visual_flow, scripted tilt, D10c); Traces tab; thread 'Tank motion' with its canned exchange.
source: concepts.md §3, §4.6; spec B1; plan D10 (U3, U4, U19); BC0 critic (M1.15b)

items.text: Header bar across the top, about 56 px tall, flat, with a 1 px hairline below.
Rocket mark and the wordmark 'RocketWright' (the product name, not the art's name).
Project switcher showing the loaded project name ('Research vehicle') with a ▾ menu.
Save state with a cloud icon and a relative time computed from the real last save ('Saved … ago').
Centred tabs Design | Propulsion | Simulate | Results.
Simulate is the active tab, marked by a 2 px teal underline.
'✓ Check model' primary button: deep teal fill, 1 px teal border, white text; its state reflects the real model check result (status, issue count).
Settings gear button opening minimal settings.
Help '?' button.
Left rail, about 17% of the width, threads group above the page navigation section, hairline divider on its right.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, threads group; S:169 seeded threads
items.text: Thread rows with icon, name, and relative age: Assembly review, Fin revision, Flight comparison (seeded).
The selected thread row is highlighted.
'+ New thread' row below the threads.
Titled navigation section 'Simulation' with a search icon and '+'.
Workspace column, about 58% of the width, between the rail and the agent pane.
Docked agent pane, about 25% of the width, full height below the header, hairline divider on its left (not a floating dock).
Pane head rendered by RocketWright above the embedded chat: thread icon and the open thread's title 'Tank motion', the same thread the left rail highlights.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; S:169 allowed deviation; U17; D10; D31
items.text: 'Agent' settings button in the pane head that opens the agent's provider and model settings (the S:169 'Agent ▾' mapping).

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§2 bubble/user; D31
items.text: The user's message in a teal-tinted bubble, radius about 6 px, with the round user avatar beside it.
An `rw:` app reference in the thread renders as a chip naming the entity, not as raw text; it resolves to a stable entity id and opens that entity in RocketWright.
App tool rows for the turn's tool calls: a leading chevron that expands the call, a tool icon, the tool's label in sans, and a teal success check.
Agent reply after the turn's tool rows and cards, written as plain prose with no bubble, under the agent's name.
Composer pinned to the bottom of the agent pane.
Composer placeholder 'Ask about this simulation…'.
Paperclip attach button.
Send button.
Bottom-right footer of the agent pane states the provenance of the data shown (it replaces the art's placeholder footer).
Design history strip along the bottom of the rail and workspace.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§6 (02); D10
items.text: Label 'Design history', then numbered step circles joined by hairlines, each with a name and date; numbers are sequential and unique, from the seeded history.
The current step has a teal ring.
'Compare' button at the end of the strip.
'⋯' menu after Compare.

items.source: C§4.6 Left rail; S:169 allowed deviation
items.text: Simulation rows: Propulsion simulation (active), Trajectory analysis, Stability analysis, Thermal analysis; the extra entries may open simple pages from existing run data.

items.source: C§6 (06); S:169 allowed deviation; U19; BC0 critic
items.text: Trajectory, Stability, and Thermal analysis each open a simple page built from existing run data; no dead rail entries.
Page title 'Propulsion simulation' (22-28 px).
Mode tabs Engineering | Visual flow | Imported CFD; Visual flow active in the capture.
Inner left column with Study and Layers.

items.source: C§4.6 Inner left column; D10 (c); U3
items.text: 'Study' list from the fixture's studies (Study 01, Tank motion, Flow overview), Study 01 selected.
'Layers' checkboxes Shell, Section, Flow, Labels.
Simulation viewport.
Cutaway: the shell is opened with a cut-face treatment and the tank is translucent.

items.source: C§4.6 Viewport; C§2 fluid; D10 (c); U4
items.text: Translucent cool-teal liquid with a tilted free surface driven by the scripted attitude.
Soft white streamlines through the feed line, engine inlet, and bell.
Labels Liquid propellant (forward tank), Feed line, Engine inlet, Engine nozzle.
Legend 'Illustrative flow preview' running Low to High.
Axis gizmo.
Transport bar under the viewport, visually separate from the design history.
'▶ Play', a scrubber, and the 'current / total s' time readout.
Speed chips 0.5× | 1× | 2×, 1× active.
'Section view' toggle.
Panel with tabs Inputs | Traces | Assumptions, Traces active.
Two normalised plots 'Relative flow' and 'Relative fill' against normalised time, synced to the transport.
Provenance label 'Visual model · Not an engineering result', bound to the result's provenance.
Buttons '↗ Open engineering run' and '⤓ Import CFD result'.
Tool row for the study run with a leading chevron, the tool's label and a teal success check.

items.source: C§4.6 Agent pane; U16; D8; D31
items.text: Linked view card (an MCP Apps card in the timeline) 'Section view · Cutaway of tank and engine' with an action that opens the view in RocketWright.
Play toggles to pause and advances the scrubber, time readout, viewport animation, and trace position; scrubbing seeks to that time.

items.source: C§4.6 Inner left column; BC0 critic
items.text: Unchecking a Layers box hides the matching viewport element (shell, section cut, flow, labels) and re-checking restores it.
Selecting another study in the Study list loads that study's viewport animation, transport duration, and traces.
Selecting Engineering or Imported CFD shows that tier's own result view and provenance instead of the visual-flow view.

items.source: C§4.6 Tabs Inputs | Traces | Assumptions; BC0 critic
items.text: Inputs tab lists the study's inputs and the Assumptions tab shows its assumptions text.
'Import CFD result' accepts an external CFD result (OpenFOAM/SU2) and stores it with imported-CFD provenance.
Viewport background is a flat soft vertical vignette (lighter top to darker bottom) with no grid behind the model.
